name: Forge
author: Pranav Babu
description: A keyboard-friendly GitHub or GitLab inbox for notifications, review requests, your own pull/merge requests, assigned issues, Actions/pipelines, and repositories/projects.

barWidget.description: One provider at a time: act on unread notifications and browse review requests, your authored pull or merge requests with their check/pipeline state, assigned issues, active or failed Actions/pipelines, and repository metrics. Switch GitHub and GitLab from Provider in settings.

schema.label: Provider
schema.description: Which forge this widget talks to. One provider at a time; switching re-fetches from the new one immediately.

schema.label: GitLab host
schema.description: Only used when Provider is GitLab. Hostname of a self-hosted instance, e.g. gitlab.example.com. Leave blank to use glab's configured default host.

schema.label: Open links
schema.description: Open links in a browser tab, or in a dedicated web app window. The web app window requires a Chromium-based default browser.

schema.label: Repository scope
schema.description: List only what you own, or widen the scope (GitHub: also your organizations; GitLab: every project you are a member of). This scope also supplies candidates for the Actions/pipeline scan.

schema.label: Include review requests and issues from archived repositories/projects
schema.description: An archived repository or project is read-only, so the request cannot be withdrawn and the work cannot be done.

schema.label: Include review requests on drafts
schema.description: Draft pull/merge requests are not ready for review, but some teams do ask for early feedback on them.

schema.label: Maximum displayed repositories/projects
schema.description: Caps rendered rows while search and filtering continue to use the complete fetched list.

schema.label: Actions/pipeline scan
schema.description: Scan none, a capped set of recent repositories/projects, or every one in the configured scope. All can use substantial API capacity with the wider scope.

schema.label: Keep the bar icon unlit
schema.description: Keep the bar icon unlit regardless of unread notifications, active runs, review requests, or failing checks. Counts and rows still populate the panel as usual.
